title: Seeding CRM và costs/outcomes
scope_items: Database Migration 00033: Created sample_requests (§19.10) and sample_shipments (§19.10) tables with composite workspace tenant keys, strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and narrow role-based grants.

Acceptance Target 1 (Request/shipment/outcome states separate): Request lifecycle (status: requested/approved/declined/fulfilled/cancelled), shipment logistics (status: preparing/shipped/delivered/lost/returned/closed), business outcome (outcome_status: pending/logged), and post-delivery follow-up (follow_up_status: pending_followup/contacted/responded/no_response) operate as orthogonal state machines. Marking delivery fulfills logistics while outcome remains pending.

Acceptance Target 2 (Missing outcome not definitive zero): Delivered samples without creator content or without traceable conversions qualify as pending outcomes rather than definitive zero revenue or failed seedings. System tags data provenance classes (official/imported/inferred/estimated/unreconciled) and qualifies overall confidence level (RULE-M18-002, RULE-M18-003).

Acceptance Target 3 (Replay no duplicate sample cost): Approval creates provisional M19 cost_item (COGS * quantity) with source_class=estimated. Shipment updates existing cost item in-place with actual shipping cost (source_class=imported). Idempotent approval/shipment replay avoids duplicate cost item creation.

Domain Rules & Edge Cases: EC-M18-001 (sample delivered but no creator response preserves pending outcome), EC-M18-002 (unlinked content cannot be official, tagged imported/inferred), EC-M18-003 (missing product COGS defaults to zero with confidence reason warning), EC-M18-004 (duplicate request detection for creator x product).
Web & Mobile Surfaces: Screen W111 Web Seeding Campaign Dashboard, Screen W112 Web Seeding Requests & Pipeline, Screen M056 Mobile Seeding CRM View.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestTarget1_OrthogonalStateMachines (Go -race), Vitest web test suite (seeding.test.ts), and Flutter mobile test suite (seeding_acceptance_test.dart) confirm strict orthogonality of request, shipment, outcome, and follow-up states.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestTarget2_MissingOutcomeNotDefinitiveZero (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm delivered samples without content are qualified as pending and not counted as zero revenue.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestTarget3_ReplayNoDuplicateSampleCost (Go -race with memory store), Vitest web idempotency test, and Flutter mobile cost evaluation confirm idempotent cost item upsert and zero duplicate costs on replay.
Edge Cases EC-M18-001 to EC-M18-004 Verified: Unit tests in Go and Flutter cover unresponsive creators, unlinked content downgrade, missing product COGS defaults, and duplicate request detection.
Migration 00033 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 33 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.
Four-Target Proto Codegen Verified: check_proto.sh passes lint, generate, drift check, buf breaking backward compatibility, Go vet/test, TypeScript vitest, and Dart test suites.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (35 files, 287 tests passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), and Flutter test suite (236 tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues) all pass.
external_gates: Migration 00033 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.
Production shipment tracking integrates with external SEA carriers (GHTK, GHN, ViettelPost, SPX); shipment tracking state machine verified locally.
Automated outcome detection integrates with TikTok and Meta graph APIs; manual outcome logging and confidence qualification verified locally.
